acceptance: Red test first: an inbox with retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-lane and retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-lane-ac-5-console defers the lane item with the reason console_companion_pending and the companion id.
The same inbox with retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-console as the only companion also defers the lane item (the shared stem without -lane).
When each companion is in consumed/, the lane item is admissible again; a console item with an unrelated id does not defer a lane item.
At shadow the item stays admissible and the decision records would_defer; at enforce it is deferred. It reuses workflow.repair.fixability.stage from repair-fixability-handoff; no new key.
fix: At admission, treat an open console-routed item as a companion of a lane item when its id starts with the lane id, or with the lane id without its -lane suffix, or when it names the lane item in deps or notes. Defer the lane item with the reason console_companion_pending until each companion is consumed.
notes: Rank 3. admission.go is not on the fence. go/internal/inboxbatch/consoleroute.go is on the fence in ADR-0157 (#1166): read it, do not change it.
routed_reason: console builds it in PR #1188 and its port onto main fixability
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator request on cycle 2035 ("balance to cost and output"). ADR-0158; plan docs/plans/cost-aware-repair-2026-10.md
summary: Ten cycles from 1983 to 2035 claimed retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-lane and used 628 LLM minutes; none shipped it. Its console companions are retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-console (on main since 2026-10-18) and retro-minting-files-through-inbox-add-lane-ac-5-console (filed by cycle 2026 on 2026-10-21, untracked in the runtime plane inbox). The lane item has deps null, so triage saw no link.
title: Triage and admission defer a lane item whose acceptance needs an open console item (ADR-0158 decision 6)
